description: This file contains functions for exporting and importing various entities such as chat flows, assistants, messages, templates, documents, tools, variables, and executions within a Flowise server environment. It also includes functions for exporting chat messages with associated artifacts and feedback, handling ID duplication, and managing workspace context during data import.

methods.name: convertExportInput
methods.description: Converts and validates the request body into an ExportInput object with boolean flags for different data types to export.

methods.name: exportData
methods.description: Fetches and compiles data entities based on export input flags and active workspace ID, returning an object with all relevant data.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForChatFlow
methods.description: Replaces duplicate chat flow IDs in the exported data with new UUIDs to prevent conflicts during import.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForAssistant
methods.description: Replaces duplicate assistant IDs in the exported data with new UUIDs.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForChatMessage
methods.description: Replaces duplicate chat message IDs and updates message references accordingly.

methods.name: replaceExecutionIdForChatMessage
methods.description: Replaces execution IDs in chat messages with null if they are missing in the imported data or database.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForChatMessageFeedback
methods.description: Replaces duplicate IDs in chat message feedback entities and removes feedback with missing references.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForCustomTemplate
methods.description: Replaces duplicate custom template IDs with new UUIDs.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForDocumentStore
methods.description: Replaces duplicate document store IDs with new UUIDs.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForDocumentStoreFileChunk
methods.description: Replaces duplicate document store file chunk IDs with new UUIDs.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForTool
methods.description: Replaces duplicate tool IDs with new UUIDs.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForVariable
methods.description: Replaces duplicate variable IDs with new UUIDs, filtering out runtime variables in cloud platform.

methods.name: replaceDuplicateIdsForExecution
methods.description: Replaces duplicate execution IDs with new UUIDs.

methods.name: reduceSpaceForChatflowFlowData
methods.description: Converts flowData strings in chat flows to JSON strings for storage.

methods.name: insertWorkspaceId
methods.description: Assigns a workspace ID to imported data entities, with special handling for Tool type entities.

methods.name: saveBatch
methods.description: Saves entities in batches to optimize database operations.

methods.name: importData
methods.description: Imports data entities into the database, handling ID replacements, workspace assignment, and transaction management.

methods.name: exportChatflowMessages
methods.description: Exports chat messages and associated artifacts, source documents, and feedback, grouped by chat session, with URL adjustments for stored files.

methods.name: getChatPK
methods.description: Generates a unique key for chat sessions based on chat ID, memory type, and session ID.

methods.name: getChatType
methods.description: Returns a string label for a given ChatType enum value.
